invalid_expected_sha256.why: import_input_workbook was called without the preview's sha256; the assistant runs preview_input_workbook first and passes its sha256.

invalid_file_id.why: preview_input_workbook / import_input_workbook got no upload id; the assistant asks the user to attach the workbook and uses its file_id.

invalid_project_name.why: get_input_workbook got a project name longer than 256 characters; the assistant asks for the exact project name.

workbook_preview_unavailable.why: import_input_workbook's confirmation card could not be built from the upload (an unexpected failure, logged with its traceback); nothing is carded or imported, and the assistant previews the workbook again.
